description: Production POET transfer and ES proposals on one-dimensional analytic objectives; no simulation.

scope.proposal_optimizer_state: fresh state: production proposal uses its SGD branch
scope.noise_pairing: Replay harness keys ES perturbations by seed, target name and donor parameters; production RNG unchanged.
scope.initial_states: Hand-constructed policies and analytic tasks; not learned populations.

claims_supported: Top-K reduces the number of production ES proposals in this controlled transfer event.
All direct donor evaluations are retained.
Direct-score screening can miss a donor whose one-step adaptation is better.
claims_not_supported: Robot locomotion quality, success rate, physical robustness or GA/GPU validation.
End-to-end POET training speedup, learning superiority, or multi-seed physical performance.
A fair fixed-budget training comparison: this script replays only one transfer event.
